news.headline:
Brokerage report suggests a 30% upside for Indus Tower.

Brokerage remains bullish on Indus Tower; reasons undisclosed.

Source: CNBC-AWAAZ

Nomura maintains Buy on Indus Towers with a target of ₹505, citing overdone correction on Jio tenancy concerns.

Nomura highlights limited tenancy loss risk, Bharti's stake support, and attractive 6.1x FY28 EV/EBITDA valuation.

Source: Livesquawk

Jaiprakash Power Ventures Ltd falls for the fifth consecutive session, trading at Rs 17.28, down 1.6%.

The stock dropped 7.3% in one year vs NIFTY's 4.9% fall and Nifty Energy's 7% rise.

Source: Business Standard

GMR Airports witnessed a Rs 42.1cr block trade on NSE for 3,741,295 shares.

The shares were traded at Rs 112.6 per share during the transaction.

Source: Livesquawk

Integra Essentia approved FY26 audited results with revenue of ₹47,361.6L and net loss ₹254.8L.

New internal auditor appointed for FY27; merger with GG Engineering awaits approvals.

Source: ScoutQuest

Maruti Suzuki saw NSE block trade worth Rs 56.2cr for ~40,650 shares.

The trade occurred at Rs 13,833 per share.

Source: Livesquawk

Sundrop Brands Ltd's board approves amalgamation between subsidiaries DMF and DMFN to streamline operations.

The merger aims for cost synergies, operational flexibility, reduced compliance costs, and improved efficiency.

Source: BSE

Granules India had an NSE block trade of 185,143 shares for Rs. 890.9.

The transaction totaled Rs. 16.49 crore, highlighting significant activity.

Source: Livesquawk

ICRA reaffirmed Prataap Snacks Ltd's long-term credit ratings at 'ICRA A', with outlook revised to negative.

The ratings cover Rs. 50 crore cash credit and Rs. 50 crore unallocated limits, totaling Rs. 100 crore.

Source: BSE

Sensex gains 238 points, Nifty stays above 23,950.

Sun Pharma rises 3%, IndiGo advances 2% in trading.

Source: ScoutQuest

Orient Electric's stock last traded at Rs 174.97, down from Rs 176.99.

Share price showed a 0.15 increase from Rs 207.90 previously.

Source: economictimes.indiatimes.com

Gold retailers faced challenges in Q1 FY27 due to duty hikes and religious factors, slowing revenue growth. Titan grew 39%, Kalyan 38%.

Gold prices fell 30%, boosting old gold exchange. Ads for exchange programs impacted margins; volumes expected to decline 13-15% in FY27.

Source: Livemint

Orient Electric plans a board meeting on July 22, 2026, to review Q1 FY2026 unaudited financial results.

Trading window remains closed until July 24, 2026, as per insider trading prevention protocols.

Source: BSE

Asian Hotels (East) fined by BSE, NSE for delayed Q4 FY26 results.

Board approved results, stated delay unintentional, will pay fine promptly.

Source: ScoutQuest

Tamil Nadu signs ₹15,037 crore MoU with Vikram Solar for battery storage plant.

The Tirunelveli plant aims to create 2,670 jobs upon establishment.

Source: The Hindu Business Line

Asian Hotels (East) Ltd approved audited standalone and consolidated financial results for Q4 and FY ending March 31, 2026.

The Board has not recommended a dividend, citing cash conservation for capex and supporting subsidiary Novak Hotels Pvt Ltd.

Source: BSE

Affordable Robotic & Automation Ltd announces board meeting on July 17, 2026, under SEBI (LODR) Regulation 29.

Meeting to consider securities issuance via preferential, rights, or other modes at Pune office.

Source: BSE

Meyer Apparel Ltd held its 33rd AGM on July 9, 2026, via video conferencing.

The company reported FY26 revenue of ₹8.7L, net loss reduced to ₹78.8L from ₹106.9L in FY25.

Source: BSE

Torrent Pharma recalls specific Semalix injection pen batches after Dr. Reddy's notification.

No risk reported for current users; other Semaglutide forms remain unaffected.

Source: ScoutQuest

Phoenix Mills Q1FY27 update: Portfolio consumption at ₹4,727 cr, up 32% YoY.

Residential sales and collections also highlighted in the business update.

Source: ET NOW

SBI subsidiary SBIFM launches IPO; price band Rs.545-574/share.

Employee discount Rs.54/share; QIB bid period closes July 16, 2026.

Source: ScoutQuest

GSPL Transmission allots 31.27 crore shares to Gujarat Energy shareholders.

Shares frozen until NSE, BSE trading approvals post GSPC merger scheme.

Source: ScoutQuest

India's battery storage tariffs rise due to higher input costs, challenging project viability.

SBI notes stalled projects from rising battery costs; Mahindra Susten warns against unrealistic tariffs.

Source: CNBC TV18

Indian defence sector's Q1FY27 expected to be seasonally soft, order books growing.

Execution gap causes revenue recognition delays despite strong order inflows.

Source: Business Standard

Sandeep Jain sold 69,792 shares of Bang Overseas Ltd at ₹28.6 avg price.

Source: NSE Bulk Trades

Dixon secures government approval for JV with China's Vivo.

Source: ScoutQuest

SBI plans IPO for subsidiary SBI Funds Management, selling 2.88 Cr shares pre-IPO.

Shares sold at Rs. 574 each, raising Rs. 1,655 Cr from 30 investors in pre-IPO deal.

Source: ScoutQuest

Marico aims for Rs 15,000 crore revenue by FY27 despite macro risks.

Source: Financial Express

Sun Pharma hits 52-week high, rallies up to 25% in a month.

Source: The Economic Times

PL Capital projects strong Q1 FY27 earnings for India's power sector with 7.4% YoY PAT growth, driven by demand recovery.

NTPC, Power Grid, and Coal India expected steady growth; Adani Energy Solutions PAT to rise 57% YoY, aided by HVDC project.

Source: CNBC TV 18

JUNOMONETA FINSOL bought 76,420 shares of Creative Newtech at an avg price of 866.9.

Source: NSE Bulk Trades

Creative Newtech Limited saw a sell transaction of 150,598 shares at Rs 866.1.

The trade was executed by NK Securities Research Pvt Ltd on 09 July 2026.

Source: NSE Bulk Trades

Polunin Emerging Markets Small Cap Fund LLC bought 600,901 shares of Unichem Labs at ₹646.4/share.

Source: NSE Bulk Trades

Silverleaf Capital Services bought 97,135 shares of Creative Newtech at ₹870.03 avg price.

Source: NSE Bulk Trades
